cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: an empty modern wave-training pool at a coastal sports laboratory — she guides a floating hoop across a gentle wave with both hands while standing in the shallow lane; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a modern community rehearsal hall after a dance class — she rewinds a rehearsal cassette by turning its spool with a pencil; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a present-day miniature puppet-theatre repair studio — she carefully untangles two puppet-control rings from an overhead hook; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — sitting on the ground; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — lying on her front; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; a forest trail junction with a wooden marker — standing
